title: SMC (k) Restored with Disability Compensation After an Overturned Reduction
content:
The SMC (k) additions in a restoration of Disability Compensation after a reduction overturned on review are one SMC (k) addition for each SMC (k) grant, up to the SMC (k) maximum:

1. for every restoration month, when the latest grant's effective date is no later than the restoration's start date;
2. for the restoration months less the whole months elapsed from the start date to that grant's effective date, when it is later — never fewer than nothing;
3. nothing, when the decision history shows no SMC (k) grant.

Each SMC (k) addition is 139.87 a month, and no more than 3 are counted. The SMC (k) grants are the rating decisions recording an SMC (k) grant.

**Cases (hypothetical; restoration start 1 March 2026; 5 restoration months)**

| Latest SMC (k) grant effective | Grants | Months with SMC (k) | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 January 2026 | 1 | 5 | 699.35 |
| 1 March 2026 (the start date) | 2 | 5 | 1398.70 |
| 15 May 2026 | 1 | 5 less 2 whole months, that is 3 | 419.61 |
| No grant | — | 0 | Nothing |
